shorts.title: What you will learn: Operators and expressions
shorts.hook: Seventeen divided by five is three, not three point four.
shorts.script: Seventeen divided by five is three, not three point four. Today your program does maths. You will meet five operators, and one surprise about division. C plus plus has five arithmetic operators. They are plus, minus, times, divide and remainder. The remainder operator is the percent sign. When both numbers are ints, the answer is also an int. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Operators and expressions in one minute
shorts.hook: C plus plus has five arithmetic operators.
shorts.script: C plus plus has five arithmetic operators. They are plus, minus, times, divide and remainder. The remainder operator is the percent sign. When both numbers are ints, the answer is also an int. The decimal part is cut off. Think of sharing laddoos. Seventeen laddoos for five friends gives each friend three. Two laddoos stay in the box. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.script: Visitors starts at ten. The plus-equals operator adds five. Now visitors is fifteen. The plus-plus operator adds one. Now it is sixteen. Here one number is a double, so the division keeps the decimal part. Seven divided by two point zero gives three point five. The program prints sixteen visitors, and then three point five. The five operators are plus, minus, times, divide and remainder. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Integer division cuts the decimals
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. We want the average of seven and eight. The answer should be seven point five. But the program prints seven. Both numbers in the division are ints, so C plus plus cuts the decimals before it stores the result. Write two point zero, and the answer is right. The division happens before the result goes into the double. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Why was the number seven so calm? It had no remainder.
shorts.script: Why was the number seven so calm? It had no remainder. A bill is two hundred and fifty rupees for four friends. Print the share and the remainder. Write your answer in the comments. The five operators are plus, minus, times, divide and remainder. Two ints divide to give an int. The percent sign gives the remainder. The short forms plus-equals and plus-plus change a variable in place. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
